[SWS_CM_10410]
ara::com::InstanceIdentifier
check during the creation
of service skeleton
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00101
⌈
The Communication Management shall check the value of the
ara::com::Instan-
ceIdentifier
argument: the identifier shall be unique. If the same
ara::com::
InstanceIdentifier
is used for the creation of more than one skeleton instance of
the same service shall be handled as violation according to [SWS_CORE_00090].
⌋
